DriveDeck 0.20.1 — Linux and Steam Deck

• First Linux packages: AppImage, Debian package and portable archive.
• Arch BTW: Linux-exclusive analog RPM and speed gauges, with “I use arch btw” in the middle.
• Desktop music controls and output-audio visualizers, with native D-Bus and PipeWire fallbacks.
• Local and HTTPS album covers supply colors for Ultra Sound, Ultra Levels and media-player visualizers.
• Companion installation detects native and Proton user folders, including SD-card Steam libraries.
• Improved Proton vehicle paths and retrying previews for Model S and Model Three.
• AppImage users can check, download and restart to update from inside DriveDeck. Other Linux packages update manually.

This release contains Linux packages only. The Windows release is unchanged.

Run DriveDeck natively on Linux (do not enable Proton for DriveDeck). BeamNG may use Proton; select its matching user folder when installing the companion, restart BeamNG, and enable Other UDP protocols.

Test feedback confirms basic telemetry, audio and navigation on Steam Deck. Broad distribution and AppImage replacement testing remain limited. Existing experimental portable users need to download this AppImage manually once.
